source: 1101 布洛妮娅 trace 阵地: 「战斗开始时，我方全体的防御力提高#2[i]%，持续#1[i]回合。」 param = [2, 0.2]
note: The trace's own numbers, and the reading order is worth checking rather than trusting: param[0] = 2 is the turn count and param[1] = 0.2 the DEF share, while the text names them the other way round (#2[i]% then #1[i] turns). 'target: all_allies' is 「我方全体」 — without it the effect would default to the rule's owner and buff only Bronya. Same shape as the Passerby 4-piece and 知更鸟's 军势: a battle-start party buff.

source: 1101 布洛妮娅 星魂 1 养精蓄锐: 「施放战技时，有#1[i]%固定概率恢复1个战技点，该效果有1回合的触发冷却。」 param = [0.5]
note: Three of the vocabularies added on 2026-09-27 meet in one sentence: min_eidolon (it IS an Eidolon, so the rank gate sits next to the mechanic rather than in a loader), chance (50%, rolled against the battle's injected generator) and cooldown ('1 回合的触发冷却' = at most once per own turn). 'actor == self' is 「施放战技时」: the cast has to be hers. This is the case engine.md §9 and SkillPointGameParityTest had registered as 'not implemented' since long before the trigger table existed — the missing part was never one hook but these three.

source: 1101 布洛妮娅 战技 作战再部署 (skill 110102, BPSkill/Support) 第二句: 「并使该目标立即行动…当对自身施放该技能时，无法触发立即行动效果。」
note: 「使该目标立即行动」 -- `target` is the unit this cast was AIMED at, which is what M-35 added to the cast events (before it, `ctx.target()` was null for every cast and this sentence was unexpressible). ⚠ The second half of the sentence is the condition: 「当对自身施放该技能时，无法触发立即行动效果」 is exactly `target != self`, and it is why this is a SEPARATE rule from the dispel/damage one below -- casting it on herself still dispels and still grants the damage boost, it just does not give her a second action.

source: 1101 布洛妮娅 战技 作战再部署 (skill 110102, BPSkill/Support): 「解除指定我方单体的1个负面效果，并使该目标立即行动，造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。」 param Lv10 = [0.66, 0, 1, 1]
note: 「解除指定我方单体的1个负面效果」 + 「造成的伤害提高 66%，持续 1 回合」, both on the aimed ally (`target: "target"`). ⚠ 0.66 is written here because MODIFY_ATTR takes a literal; it is the Lv10 row the prose quotes (Lv1 = 0.33, Lv15 = 0.825) -- the same 「which row」 question `damage_level` answers for the ops that read a table (M-32). ⚠ `DISPEL` on a target with nothing to remove is not an error (the op's contract: 「取不到不算错」). ⚠ No condition on the aimed unit beyond `actor == self`, because this half applies in BOTH cases -- only the immediate action is barred for a self-cast, which is why that one is gated `target != self`.

source: 1101 布洛妮娅 星魂 6 气贯长虹 (Avatar_Bronya_Rank06): 「战技对指定我方目标造成的伤害提高效果的持续时间增加1回合。」 param = [1]
note: 「战技对指定我方目标造成的**伤害提高效果**的持续时间增加1回合」: the sentence names an effect rather than a state, and the engine's handle for it is the attribute the modifier sits on (`ALL_DAMAGE_TYPE_BOOST`) -- which is the Skill rule's own `MODIFY_ATTR` in the rule above. ⚠ `min_eidolon: 6` is the whole of what makes this an Eidolon (the engine knows nothing else about 星魂). ⚠ Why the filter is stated rather than "lengthen everything I applied": her 「作战再部署」 trace gives the whole party +20% DEFENCE for 2 turns at BATTLE_START, and that buff can still be ticking when she casts her Skill -- a filter that said "all of mine" would silently add a turn to it as well. That is the case the attribute/name axis exists to prevent (`ExtendBuffTest.itDoesNotLengthenTheOwnersOtherBuffs`). ⚠ NOT authored from this Eidolon: nothing else -- it is a one-sentence Eidolon.

source: 1101 布洛妮娅 终结技（数据出处 skill_id 110102）: 「使我方全体攻击力提高55%…持续2回合」
note: 「使我方全体**攻击力提高 55%**…持续 **2 回合**」—— `MODIFY_ATTR ATTACK` + `percent: 0.55` ✓ + `turns: 2` ✓ + `all_allies` ✓；⭐ **数值出处在数据里定位到 `skill_id 110102`** ✓ （⚠ 前两次取不到的原因已记入文档 ✓：她的 id 是 6 位 ✓，且**该 id 自己的块里没有 `param` 数组** ✗ ⇒ 必须按"值出现的位置反查最近的 skill_id" ✓）。

source: 1101 布洛妮娅 终结技: 「同时提高等同于布洛妮娅16.00%暴击伤害+20.00%的暴击伤害，持续2回合」
note: 「提高**等同于布洛妮娅 16.00% 暴击伤害 + 20.00%** 的暴击伤害，持续 2 回合」—— **派生量** ✓：`scale: "self_attr:CRIT_ATTACK"` + `percent: 0.16` + `amount: 0.20` ✓（与大丽花行迹同族 ✓）；⭐ 比率型属性用派生量是对的 ✓；⚠ **快照语义** ✓（触发瞬间读取并冻结 ✓）。
